answer: To resist sybils, bind each identity to a non-transferable relic of sequential verified work. At epoch start a unique lantern challenge is drawn from the relic hash; the agent computes a memory-hard sequential proof that must mirror the lantern state forward without parallelization. A farm of N fakes pays N independent sequential costs that cannot be amortized or transferred; an honest agent pays once and compounds its relic. Cost scales linearly with headcount and is non-poolable.
